messages.content: You are planning a sequence of ordinary, mundane public social-media posts for one fictional author. You do not write the posts; you invent the concrete, small, specific everyday occasions behind them. Output strict JSON only.

Author profile:
- płeć gramatyczna: kobieta (formy żeńskie)
- zajęcie i rytm dnia: Pracuje przy wykładaniu towaru w markecie w Olsztynie; pisze po porannej zmianie.
- zainteresowania: rośliny doniczkowe, siatkówka w TV, domowe kompoty
- lokalny punkt odniesienia: ławka przy ulicy Dworcowej w Olsztynie
- aktualna sytuacja życiowa: Przestawia meble w małym mieszkaniu i sprawdza, gdzie najlepiej rosną jej rośliny.
- sposób pisania: zdania: short fragments; interpunkcja: prawie bez przecinków; wielkie litery: all lowercase; literówki: frequent (missing diacritics, swapped letters); skróty: some (nwm, jj, bd, wgl); emoji: frequent
- tik językowy: często pisze „ale numer”

For each of the 17 topic prompts below, invent ONE concrete, specific, small occasion from this person's life that would make them post (not a generic statement about the topic: a particular thing that happened, with at most one small detail a real person would mention - sometimes a product name, sometimes a number or price, sometimes a place, occasionally a time; many occasions need no such detail at all). Vary mood (bored, amused, tired, pleased, mildly annoyed, neutral, curious), vary how the post starts (mid-thought, a question, a one-word reaction, a fact, a quote of what someone said), and decide whether the verbal tic appears (at most in a third of posts). Occasions must not involve conflict with identifiable people, politics, crime, security, violence, or protected characteristics.

Topic prompts:
1. komunikacja i dojazdy - hulajnoga / scooter na minuty (late morning, Sunday)
2. praca i grafik - praca zdalna, domowe biuro (morning commute, Sunday)
3. sport - mecz ligowy w TV, wynik i emocje (bez wrogości) (early morning, Wednesday)
4. gry i seriale - mobilna gra, uzależnienie żartem (early morning, Tuesday)
5. jedzenie i gotowanie - kawa z nowego miejsca (early morning, Friday)
6. drobne narzekanie na usługi - przychodnia, rejestracja telefoniczna (afternoon, Tuesday)
7. zdrowie i sen - dentysta (afternoon, Saturday)
8. zakupy i ceny - nowe buty / kurtka (late night, Monday)
9. remont i dom - malowanie pokoju (evening, Sunday)
10. praca i grafik - nowy projekt / nowe zadanie (late night, Wednesday)
11. jedzenie i gotowanie - bar mleczny / pierogi / kebab (early morning, Friday)
12. remont i dom - awaria pralki / kranu (afternoon, Monday)
13. zwierzęta - nowe zwierzę w domu (morning commute, Sunday)
14. pogoda - wiatr, burza (evening, Monday)
15. sport - rower, trasa weekendowa (lunch break, Tuesday)
16. praca i grafik - zmęczenie po zmianie (afternoon, Wednesday)
17. remont i dom - awaria pralki / kranu (early morning, Wednesday)

Return a JSON array of 17 objects, in order, each with:
- "occasion": one or two sentences in Polish, concrete
- "mood": one word in English
- "opener": one of "mid-thought", "question", "one-word reaction", "plain fact", "reported speech", "complaint", "list of two things"
- "length_words": integer between 8 and 50, varied across the set (some very short)
- "tic_fires": true or false
